voices.line: Right. Seal the ring, light the apron, and this rock's a home.
Airlock's sealed behind you. I'm Nia. Breathe easy, you're inside.
We could make room for a second dome.
One more piece in place.
Hello! I'm Tomas. I hear you're new round here.
If I had a spare seal, I'd sleep at night.
You went all that way for this?
I wanted to tell you something. All quiet this week. Only that I fixed Nia Chen's kit. Come by soon.
The supply drop! What do we do with it?
The Earth window opens tonight. Can I have the long call? My sister's having a baby.
It's a girl! Eight minutes' delay and I couldn't stop grinning.
A workshop dome by Ares Habitat. I'll be using that.
For your first day in the colony. Welcome.
Every suit has a name. Mine's called Rusty.
Nobody's touched it.
Help me fit a spare seal?
My sister sent a picture of the baby! Shall we pin it up in the mess?
I'd like to send a message home.
Look at her. Everyone keeps stopping to wave.
An engineer called Yusuf Adeyemi came in on the supply shuttle.
Here's something about the craters I've never said. Every one of them has a name now. We named them.
All of us, together. Like the first day.
Half each.
Tomas hardly gets out. Would you ask them along for a walk?
They'll get it in a few days.
A few lines, since I didn't see you today. Life goes on here: I harvested wheat in Hydroponics Bay with Tomas Vale, and we had words. Yours, Nia.
Just one trip past the edge of the map.
Snug as anything.
A schoolroom! Just what Ares Habitat needed.
Can I tell you something about Tomas? We nod in passing. That's about it.
A reply from home! Read it with me?
You should see what's out there!
Looks like Yusuf Adeyemi's staying. Fine by me.
Our own road. We made it one tyre at a time.
I've wanted to work somewhere like the workshop dome all my life.
Found a guitar in the cargo! Music night in the mess?
They say hello to you too!
Evenings are long on my own.
Hello! I'm Yusuf. I hear you're new round here.
Out past the edge there's an old shelter. Make it ours?
I cracked a wheel on the ridge. Print a new one tonight, or patch the old one?
Three chords and everyone singing. Perfect.
A solar array by Hydroponics Bay. I'll be using that.
Quiet shift. Sit by the bay with me. The wheat hums, if you listen.
Hello! I'm Sasha. I hear you're new round here.
Ration day. Algae loaf again, or shall we open the last tin of peaches?
Good as new. Better, actually: I gave it more tread.
The first of us slept in here. It still smells of new plastic.
Come for a test drive on the new wheel? Just out to the crater rim and back.
There. That's ours now.
Maybe tomorrow.
A pilot called Priya Raman came in on the supply shuttle.
Funny, we've never talked about the cold. Your breath fogs in the airlock every morning.
A dust front on the horizon!
Syrup and all. Best thing I've tasted in a year.
You built that? Well, look at it.
Sasha Petrov makes it look easy. Could I learn from them?
I wanted to tell you something. Big news round here: Sasha, an engineer from Phobos, came because of the workshop dome you built. More when I see you.
Green! Actual green!
Here we are again. The supply drop! What do we do with it?
Smooth as anything. I could drive to the ridge on that.
I've never told you about Tomas, have I? We get on well enough.
Where were you?
Nobody's touched it.
It's a failing seal. I need a hand, now!
The tomato flowers are open, and there are no bees on Mars. Help me pollinate them with a paintbrush?
Every single flower. My arm's dead. The tomatoes will thank us.
Copy. Airlock B reads steady. I'll check again at dusk.
Listen. Sasha Petrov spotted a dust devil. We watched it dance, no joke.
Supper with Sasha Petrov. Rehydrated stew, fine company.
Mapped another ridge from Hydroponics Bay.
Sasha Petrov gets me. Rare, that.
Looks like Priya Raman's staying. Fine by me.
Don't log this. Some nights I check the seals twice. I'm afraid.
I've never told you what I think of the day Yusuf Adeyemi and Sasha Petrov became firm friends. It always puts me in a good mood.
They told me about your schoolroom. I had to see it.
Half each.
The first tomato's red! Share it round, or save it for seed?
A dust front left dust in everything.

panels.caption: Tomas was the first down to Ares Habitat for the first sprouts.
The first sprouts broke the soil in the greenhouse, around the workshop dome you made.
Tomas was the last to leave Ares Habitat after the first sprouts.
The spring sky went dark, and Tomas watched it come.
A dust front caught them apart.
Tomas helped clear Ares Habitat before breakfast.
Priya was asking round for a room in spring.
Priya Raman, a pilot from Phobos, stayed on, and nobody minded.
By the end of spring, everyone knew Priya.
